import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

df_grouped = df.groupby(['product', 'size'], as_index=False)['quantity'].sum()

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
sns.barplot(x='product', y='quantity', hue='size', data=df_grouped, hue_order=['Small', 'Medium', 'Large'])
plt.title('Total Quantity Sold per Coffee Product by Size', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('Product Type', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Quantity Sold', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Size', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
